name: Agency Home with Signature Stage
sequence: identity thesis -> signature stage -> services/capabilities -> selected work -> proof -> contact
use_when: agency/brand studio needs memorable identity and proof
notes: Keep spectacle bounded and route to work

name: Editorial Agency Case Detail
sequence: project premise -> context/problem -> intervention -> large media chapters -> outcomes -> reflection -> next project/contact
notes: Avoid uniform feature-card case pages

name: Portfolio Home + Featured Work
sequence: identity -> about signal -> featured works -> service/value signal -> contact
notes: One expressive signature plus readable work list

name: Reflective Portfolio Case
sequence: problem -> intervention -> result -> tradeoffs -> what changes next -> learning
notes: Persistent rail optional on desktop

name: Developer Product Home
sequence: editorial hero -> code/product proof -> DX capabilities -> test/webhooks/editor -> contact/broadcast -> framework proof -> CTA
notes: Evidence precedes broad claims

name: Developer Product -> Docs Bridge
sequence: product claim -> minimal implementation example -> deeper docs/action -> related capability
notes: Keep code truthful and copy short

name: World-Led Launch Journey
sequence: world hero -> trailer -> premise/story -> characters/world chapters -> media/exploration -> news -> back-of-box -> conversion/outro
notes: One campaign job per chapter

name: Evidence-First Directory Home
sequence: scope/thesis -> quick provider summary -> compare/directory entry -> methodology/confidence -> FAQ/glossary
notes: Make confidence/provenance visible

name: Directory Browse Route
sequence: filters/scope -> dense list/table -> freshness/confidence -> methodology link -> detail navigation
notes: Density high but outer layout stable

name: Comparison Route
sequence: comparison controls -> horizontally contained matrix -> evidence/freshness -> methodology -> selected detail actions
notes: Internal horizontal scroll is acceptable

name: One-Record Data Detail
sequence: identity -> key metrics -> evidence/provenance -> caveats -> alternatives -> update/freshness -> compare action
notes: Do more than repeat directory row

name: Enterprise AI Operational Home
sequence: enterprise thesis -> model/context proof -> workspace -> knowledge/context -> pipeline -> use cases -> pricing -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: Operational pipeline carries product explanation

name: Enterprise Trust Satellite System
sequence: home core -> integrations -> pricing -> company -> blog -> careers -> contact/demo -> FAQ -> legal/privacy
notes: Do not duplicate home everywhere

name: Agent SaaS Conversation-to-Action Home
sequence: agent claim -> shared platform -> conversation-to-action proof -> systems/integrations -> changelog -> outcomes -> pricing -> FAQ -> testimonials/content -> CTA
notes: Show action/result, not chat alone

name: Agent SaaS Content + Trust Routes
sequence: blog/changelog -> detail -> related content -> conversion; legal/support routes stay simple
notes: Quarantine demo/template residue

name: AI Service Commercial Core
sequence: hero -> why choose -> feature/tool value -> services -> numbered process -> results -> testimonials -> pricing -> comparison -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: Keep most commercial teaching on one page

name: AI Service Trust Satellites
sequence: commercial core -> contact -> privacy -> changelog -> changelog details
use_when: small service site needs support routes
notes: Avoid many thin duplicate marketing pages

name: Game Studio Home
sequence: world/studio hero -> studio thesis -> services -> cases -> awards/trust -> insights -> app/contact CTA
notes: Studio/company is product, not a single title

name: Game Studio Service Family
sequence: service index -> service detail -> capability/process -> related cases -> contact
notes: Pair every capability family with proof

name: Game Studio Case Family
sequence: case index -> case detail -> project context -> visual stages -> outcome/process -> related cases
notes: Sticky project stages only when readable

name: Immersive Single-Route Journey
sequence: entry gate -> weighted chapters -> event peaks -> payoff -> delayed coda/replay
notes: One authoritative progress domain

name: AI SaaS Dense Commercial Home
sequence: hero -> trust -> how it works -> features -> solution -> stats -> agent/tool proof -> content -> cases -> pricing -> integrations -> testimonials -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: Use operational micro-scenes to avoid abstract bloat

name: Integration Index by Job Taxonomy
sequence: integration thesis -> category taxonomy -> connector list -> related proof/CTA
notes: Categories reflect user jobs

name: Integration Detail as Implementation Proof
sequence: identity/job -> introduction -> capabilities -> installation -> setup metadata -> setup action -> sales fallback -> related integrations
notes: All fields must bind to same connector record

name: Outcome-Structured Case Study
sequence: hero/client -> challenge -> solution/implementation -> quantified outcomes -> related cases -> CTA
notes: Verify metrics and hero/body identity

name: Editorial Blog Family
sequence: blog index -> featured/recent -> article metadata -> long-form body -> related -> conversion
notes: Run duplicate-content canary across family

name: Compressed Pricing Decision Route
sequence: pricing thesis -> plans -> proof/comparison -> testimonial/FAQ -> CTA
notes: Keep page shorter than product home

name: Legal / Policy Trust Route
sequence: document identity/date -> legal sections -> contact/footer
notes: No template placeholders or stale domains

name: Branded 404 Recovery
sequence: clear error -> recovery action -> optional brand cue -> footer
notes: Do not give 404 equal design weight to core routes

name: Whimsical World Portfolio Home
sequence: identity -> teach world vocabulary -> featured collection -> case proof -> taxonomy -> evolution proof -> world map -> truthful stats/achievements -> service quests -> process -> about/origin -> logbook -> contact/save point
use_when: a personal/studio portfolio uses one coherent fictional/collectible system to organize real work and services
notes: teach how to read the metaphor early; keep real role and navigation visible

name: Mnemonic Collection Index
sequence: collection thesis -> numbered/typed records -> mnemonic identity + real project cue -> direct detail action -> contact
use_when: a compact body of work benefits from collection memory and browsing
notes: critical metadata cannot live only on hover/flip back faces

name: Mnemonic Case Detail
sequence: mnemonic title/number/type -> premise -> client/year/scope/result -> brief -> intervention -> outcome -> related/evolved records -> contact
use_when: a creative case study needs memorable identity plus conventional professional evidence
notes: use one meaningful H1 even if display treatment visually resembles a section title

name: World Taxonomy Detail
sequence: real category title -> short promise -> world/category identity -> related work/index action -> all categories -> contact
use_when: discipline/category routes are navigational taxonomy surfaces rather than full sales pages
notes: category label must remain semantic text, not only color or emblem

name: Themed Productized Service Detail
sequence: themed service title -> plain outcome -> price/range -> duration -> approach -> deliverables -> primary action -> all services -> contact
use_when: small creative service offers have fixed or bounded scope
notes: metaphor never replaces price/timing/deliverable clarity

name: One-Page Game Studio Home
sequence: hero -> scale proof -> media reset -> services -> featured games -> character/world art -> testimonials -> FAQ -> team -> contact -> final trust -> footer
use_when: compact game studio/service marketing can support one complete decision journey
notes: split into route families when cases/services need deep proof or search intent

name: One-Page Studio 404 Recovery
sequence: clear error -> return home -> essential anchors -> footer
use_when: single-route marketing still needs branded recovery
notes: return real HTTP 404; keep utility route out of sitemap unless intentionally indexable

name: Single-Title Atmospheric Game Campaign
sequence: hero -> trailer -> premise -> world survey -> story -> gameplay -> systems -> recovered footage -> character -> sound -> release -> press -> final wishlist
use_when: one narrative game title needs a complete marketing journey without multi-route depth
notes: every chapter needs one proof/decision job; quarantine fictional claims and placeholder external destinations
